cariboo.title: Incumbent faces off against former mayor in Williams Lake election
cariboo.description: It will be a choice between two experienced candidates when Williams Lake voters go to the polls for the Oct. 17 municipal election.

southeast.title: B.C. man reunited with beloved flute, 5 years after it floated away down a Yukon river
southeast.description: Jun Takahashi was stunned when he saw the online post: someone in the Yukon bush had found a canoe barrel full of his mildew-y camping gear, and his long-lost flute.

all.title: Pattullo Bridge arches to be removed over Thanksgiving long weekend
all.description: Business owners near the Pattullo Bridge hope improved traffic flow will mean more customers, as crews began removing the bridge’s steel arches Friday — one more step toward completing the long-awaited replacement project.
